sample_features_at_coords: sample feature values from a feature map tensor at normalized point coordinates using bilinear interpolation
generate_regular_grid_coords: generate a regular square grid of normalized point coordinates for a given number of regions and side size
get_uncertain_point_coords_with_randomne: sample uncertain point coordinates from coarse logits using importance sampling combined with random sampling
get_uncertain_point_coords_on_grid: find the most uncertain points from an uncertainty map grid and return their indices and normalized coordinates
sample_point_labels_from_masks: sample ground truth mask labels at given point coordinates from BitMasks instances for training
